newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Adsteam plans A$160 mln marine float.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Adsteam plans A$160 mln marine float.

text.p: Adsteam Marine Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to raise A$160 million from the initial public offering of 80 million shares at A$2.00 each.
Adsteam Marine is being floated by its parent Residual Assco Group Ltd, which recently changed its name from The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd.
Adelaide Marine said its float prospectus had been registered with the Australian Securities Commission.
The offer had been underwritten by joint lead managers BZW Australia Ltd and SBC Warburg Australia Ltd.
A maximum of 20 percent of the shares would be allocated to Residual Assco shareholders.
The towage services company expected to list on the Australian Stock Exchange in the second half of June, with the offer due to close by at least June 4.
The prospectus forecast a rise in 1996/97 earnings before interest, tax and abnormals to A$24.4 million and A$26.8 million next year compared with A$23 million in 1995/96.
Shareholders would receive dividends next year, with a first half payment of six cents in April 1998 and seven cents per share in November 1998.
Adsteam Marine managing director David Ryan said the Sydney-based company had a fleet of 71 tugs and represented about 58 percent of the total Australian tug fleet. It has 654 employees.
